evaluation.summary: Integrate the current N1/N2 Rust authority with selected CELS presentation/Harper patterns and GEL Planner state/safety patterns. React is presentation-only; Rust owns semantic drafts; UI1 exposes no GEL tutorial write capability. UI1e implements native window close interception, navigation discard guards, and stale_source / session invalidation handling.

architecture.rust_application_service: sole owner of active tutorial semantic draft and typed draft mutation boundary
architecture.live_source_acquisition: N1/N2 fixed authenticated GET surfaces only
architecture.submission: production submission command ui1_submit_draft delegating to live_submission_transport
architecture.draft_persistence: none; active tutorial drafts are in-memory only
architecture.harper_dictionary: active UI1d durable local Writer preference state, separate from archive and tutorial drafts
architecture.semantic_option_authority: Rust gel-core semantic enums/view models; React must not define canonical CEFR or GEL value domains
architecture.validation_error_authority: Rust DraftValidationIssue structured DTO; React must not infer fields by parsing messages
architecture.aims_assistance: ui1c_aims_assistance is absent_not_curated; no preset UI is authorized
architecture.harper_service: Rust-owned harper-core 2.8.0 British-English assistance; React receives DTOs with span coordinates and suggestion labels only
architecture.draft_staleness: session expiry (HTTP 401/403 or login redirect) or latest tutorial remote drift transitions active draft to stale_source; silent rebinding is strictly forbidden
architecture.window_close_interception: native close request (tauri::WindowEvent::CloseRequested) intercepted when draft status is dirty; DiscardDraftDialog triggered with action 'closing the application'

archive.configuration: Archive selection is Rust-owned. A non-empty GEL_ARCHIVE_DB overrides selection. When unset/blank on Windows, Writer resolves gel-new-v2.db beside the running executable; non-Windows uses project-root gel-new-v2.db. A2 RustArchiver may atomically create a missing schema-v2 DB and explicitly synchronize it after GEL authentication; existing invalid/non-v2 files fail closed without in-place migration.
archive.access: ArchiveRepository::open_read_only for navigation; explicit ui1_sync_archive delegates canonical mutation to RustArchiver

harper_future_state.storage: separate Writer-local durable JSON state beside resolved archive by default; GEL_HARPER_DICTIONARY override

initial_exit_conditions: React invokes only the explicit UI1a/b command allowlist.
No UI1 Tauri command can submit/mutate a GEL tutorial; the sole local archive mutation command is ui1_sync_archive, which delegates to RustArchiver.
Archive navigation is read-only and works independently of GEL authentication.
Opening New uses N2b/N2c authoritative source construction; React does not synthesize today/current-teacher/prepopulation.
Opening Revision uses governed D2 + C1/C2 authority and fails closed when revision authority is blocked.
The Rust active draft is ephemeral and candidate-before-commit edits cannot mutate teacher/origin/identity.
Teacher comments are authoritatively bounded at 970 Unicode scalar values in Rust.
Canonical CEFR option values are projected from Rust semantic authority; React carries no independent CEFR level list.
Frontend password state is cleared after every login attempt and no browser persistence API is used.
The selected A+D hybrid layout is strictly accepted under ui1-hybrid PASS=23 SKIP=0 FAIL=0.
